observations: Photo 0: a yellow/orange gas cylinder, top valve area shown, some faint handwritten/printed marks on the collar but no legible brand or kg size, valve has visible rust spots.
Photo 1: a different, blue gas cylinder with cast lettering 'BERADISCO' on the body, paint worn at the collar and handles, valve area dark/rusty.
Photo 2: a close-up top view of the same blue cylinder from photo 1, valve looks weathered with rust/oxidation, no new or shiny parts visible.
No certification sticker, test date stamp, or weight/kg stamp is legible in any photo.
The listing claims to be a single 12.5kg cylinder, but two visually distinct cylinders (different color, different brand) appear across the three photos.

claims.evidence: No kg stamp or size marking is legible in any photo; two different cylinders are shown, so even the single-item identity is unclear.
No certification sticker, inspection stamp, or document visible in any photo.
Leak testing cannot be done from photos; no soap-bubble test or gauge shot provided.
Photo 1 and photo 2 show a valve with visible rust/oxidation and worn finish, not consistent with a new part.

risks.risk: Listing photos show two different cylinders (different color and brand), raising doubt about which item, if any, will actually be delivered.
risks.proof: A single set of photos (all angles) of the one specific cylinder being sold, including a shot of its kg stamp and manufacture/test date.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unidentified/mismatched item, priced at the lowest worst case for an unverified used cylinder

risks.risk: Valve condition and age not verifiable, could be unsafe or near end-of-life despite 'new valve' claim.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of valve brand/date stamp and a video of gas connection test with no hiss/smell.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having an old/unverified valve, not new

risks.risk: No proof of recent certification or safety testing (NMDPRA/SON stamp).
risks.proof: Photo of certification sticker or test report with date and cylinder serial number matching the item.
Video of soap-water test on valve and seams showing no bubbles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as leak-unverified (worst case: not guaranteed leak-free)

proof_requests: Clear photos of the actual single cylinder being sold, all from the same unit, including the kg stamp and manufacturer plate.
Photo or video of the certification/test sticker with a readable date.
Video of a soap-bubble leak test on the valve and body seams.
Explanation for why two different-colored/branded cylinders appear in the same listing.
response.reason: The three photos show two visually distinct cylinders (a yellow one and a blue 'BERADISCO' one) for what is advertised as a single 12.5kg cylinder, and the valve shown is visibly worn/rusty despite the 'new valve' claim, which together suggest mismatched or misrepresented photos rather than a verifiable single item.
